headlines.title: Water industry turns to AI and hackers for help after suspected Iran cyberattacks
headlines.description: For the new initiative, Vanderbilt University researchers will work to create “digital twins” of water system networks.

headlines.title: Sen. Cassidy announces he will support Blanche's nomination as attorney general
headlines.description: Sen. Bill Cassidy, R-La., announced he would be supporting Todd Blanche's nomination to serve as attorney general. In his speech on the Senate floor, Cassidy explained his reasoning for the decision and voiced some concerns about the Trump administration's relationship with the Justice Department.

headlines.title: Rep. Andy Ogles loses his Republican primary in Tennessee
headlines.description: Rep. Andy Ogles of Tennessee has lost his Republican primary, NBC News projects, falling to a former state official in a primary season that has seen an unusually high number of incumbents lose renomination.

headlines.title: Sen. Marsha Blackburn wins the Republican primary for governor of Tennessee
headlines.description: Blackburn, a longtime Trump ally, defeated Rep. John Rose for the nomination, NBC News projects, after the president decided not to endorse in the race.

headlines.title: Meta Ordered to Pay $567M in New Mexico Child Safety Case
headlines.description: A judge in New Mexico has ordered Meta, the parent company of Facebook and Instagram, to pay a massive $567 million penalty as part of a landmark trial. That amount is on top of the $375 million in damages imposed by a judge earlier this year who found Meta knowingly harmed children’s mental health on its platforms. NBC’s Brian Cheung reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Influencer Sydney Towle dies at 26 after documenting rare cancer illness
headlines.description: Sydney Towle, who shared her treatment for a rare form of cancer called Cholangiocarcinoma, has died. Towle used her social media to challenge assumptions about how people with serious illnesses live their lives. NBC News' Dana Griffin reports.

headlines.title: Miss North Carolina USA stripped of her crown after alleged past racist comments resurface
headlines.description: Miss North Carolina USA will no longer compete in Miss USA after organizers said she failed to uphold the pageant’s “standards and values,” raising questions about the future of beauty pageants in the U.S. NBC News’ Erin McLaughlin reports.

headlines.title: AI is looking for thousands of people to dig trenches for internet cables
headlines.description: The AI-powered growth of data centers is driving demand for human workers to lay new fiber optic cables from coast to coast.

headlines.title: U.S. bans many new foreign made robots
headlines.description: The FCC won’t allow many new foreign made robotic devices, a lot of them coming from China, to be sold in the U.S., citing national security and economic concerns. NBC News’ Brian Cheung reports.

headlines.title: White House hosts meeting with top AI companies
headlines.description: The White House hosted a meeting with representatives from top AI companies, including Anthropic, Meta and OpenAI. President Trump did not attend the meeting which was focused on voluntary AI safety testing for advanced AI models.

headlines.title: Ukraine's robotic amphibious landing signals global arms race of autonomous weapons
headlines.description: From robotic beach landings to AI-powered "Terminator" drones, what was once the realm of sci-fi is now becoming reality on the battlefield in Ukraine. The pioneering of autonomous weapons is sparking a global arms race with the U.S., Russia and China racing to keep up. NBC News' Matt Bradley reports.

headlines.title: Urgent warning over water system cyberattacks
headlines.description: The Trump administration is warning about potential cyberattacks after a senior law enforcement official told NBC News that a cyberattack on water systems in Minnesota had all the hallmarks of Iranian-backed hackers. NBC News’ Garrett Haake reports.
